{{Top|leg}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] '''Xita''' was an eccentric [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who tried to flee a battle on an experimental [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]]. A group of beings tried to pursue Xita, eventually boarding Xita's ship. However, the experimental [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was activated and was damaged in the process, stranding them deep in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Xita eventually became ill with a sickness caused by exposure to the experimental hyperdrive, but was eventually cured.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
